theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_int_combination_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T₁ → R₂.Represents T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = (p₁ : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (p₂ : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents S ∧ R.measure ≤ (p₁.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₁.measure + (p₂.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₂.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
